rv.q: There is a heartfelt reverence to Catholicism, explored through the quiet faith of Jesus’ mother, who finds comfort in its rituals.
Yes, JEEZUS! will shock and offend, and it sets out to do just that.

cn.t: Provocative exploration of faith and queerness earns strong reviews for its daring subject matter and blisteringly good performances, though its shocking appropriation of religious imagery won't be for everyone.
